Indirect emissions
associated with
an organisation’s
activity – the
things that the
organisation has
affluence over, not
a direct influence.
(At JHL this includes
business travel - air
& road, employee
commuting,
purchased goods
and services,
investments.)
There was a
3.22% reduction
in 2023 due to the
following:
Fluctuations in
the exchange
rate leading to
depreciation
in value of the
Shilling in the
Kenyan, Ugandan
and Tanzanian
Markets.
